items.reason: Although the handler lacks a method guard, apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:25-31 requires the secret in a request header and validates req.body; a prefetched URL or ordinary cross-site GET cannot supply these. Credential writes also require decryptable keys at lines 57-59, and packages/lib/constants.ts:103-104 disables sharing unless both secrets are configured, so the claimed CSRF credential overwrite does not follow from accepting GET.
